title: Warmly Spiced Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A cultured and crisp Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, warmly spiced with cajun flavors, served in individual mini cocottes, and suitable for a Jain friendly diet, inspired by monsoon season
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the lamb pieces to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cajun spice, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the dried apricots and chicken broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to individual mini cocottes.
Cover the cocottes with lids and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the cocottes from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, topped with toasted bread cubes.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
